subtitle: Live, open-source screening for automated-research attacks on peer review
question: Can a language-model pipeline tell when a submission closely matches earlier public work it does not credit?
mission: Red-flag Research studies how automated tools can be turned against the research process, for example to rewrite earlier work into a paper that looks new. Reusing work without credit is one such attack, and screening for it is where we start.
intro: Our first application screens all 43,013 ICLR 2027 submissions in public, in nine stages, and shows every step as it happens. A flag is a lead for a person to check, not a finding of misconduct.
author: Ziqian Zhang
